name: Storyboard Studio
intro: Storyboard Studio in SmartVideo turns a short description into a plan of shots, draws each one as an image frame, and lets you edit and export the result.

features.describe-and-generate-a-storyboard: Type your idea in the main box, like a launch ad for a running shoe, then press Generate storyboard to get a full shot plan.
features.customize-panel: The Customize panel offers optional fields like title, video type and tone, which steer the story and help keep the same look in every frame.
features.also-generate-frame-images: Next to the Generate button, a checkbox is ticked by default so every frame is drawn right after planning and you get pictures straight away.
features.frame-cards: Each frame card lets you move, duplicate or delete the shot, and set its shot type, so you keep fine control over every shot.
features.start-from-shot-preset: Start from shot preset fills the description with a starter for the chosen shot type, which helps when you are staring at a blank page.
features.generate-all-frames-retry-failed: Generate all frames draws every frame with a description and shows progress as it goes. You can stop it, or retry any that failed.
features.save-load-and-export: Name your project and save it, then load it later. The Export menu lets you share your plan, for example as a PDF shot sheet.
features.send-to-video-studio-and-animate: When the plan feels right, send your frames to the video studio, or animate a single frame, to turn the plan into video.

outro: Describe an idea, refine your frames, and Storyboard Studio gives you a plan you can take straight into video.
